# Math

Inline $x^2 + y^2 = z^2$ in a sentence, with $\alpha \le \beta$ and
$\mathbb{R} \subset \mathbb{C}$ too.

$$
\frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}
$$

Sums and integrals: $\sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}$.

$$
\int_0^\infty e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
$$

$$
\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix} ax + by \\ cx + dy \end{pmatrix}
$$

$$
f(x) = \begin{cases}
  x & x \ge 0 \\
  -x & x < 0
\end{cases}
$$

$$
\begin{align}
  (a+b)^2 &= a^2 + 2ab + b^2 \\
  (a-b)^2 &= a^2 - 2ab + b^2
\end{align}
$$

Accents and roots: $\hat{x}$, $\vec{v}$, $\bar{z}$, $\sqrt[3]{8} = 2$,
$\binom{n}{k}$, and $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x} = 1$.

An unsupported macro like $\undefinedmacro{x}$ must stay visible.
